scenarios.name: placed with three components: the start page is built at once — Top Component Name Home, Stack Depth 1, one child; Did Mount
a push with the default transition (Push, 300 ms): Detail on top, Stack Depth 2, two children while it plays, Done; the page below leaves the children at the first frame past 300 ms
two pushes with no transition in one frame: both Done, Stack Depth 3, Detail on top, one child
two animated pushes in one frame: the first is Done, the second is refused — the stack is still animating
a push, then the pushed page's Pop: the pusher is handed the back's action and results, then the back is Done — Home on top, Stack Depth 1; a Pop in the start page reaches no stack
a Reset after a push: the stack goes back to its start page, Done
a replace after a push: the replaced page is the only one — Stack Depth 1, Done
no components: the mount's reset reports to no one; a Reset is Failure component-stack/no-components
a push before the first frame: the start page is built first, then the push — Stack Depth 2, Detail, Done
a push to a stack named Other waits in the handler; naming this stack Other replays it — reset first, then the push
Mounted off, then on: Will Unmount, Did Mount — and the stack is rebuilt at its start page
a push of a page the stack does not have is Failure component-not-found; a push of the page already on top is Unchanged, whatever its transition
a push and a replace of the page already showing are Unchanged
a push and a Pop in the same frame: the Pop is the start page's — it reaches no stack; the push is Done
an animated push and a Pop in the same frame: the push is Done, the Pop reaches nothing
row C108 — a push with a transition there is no such thing as (Fade) plays none and is Done; the next push is Done
row C109 — a Components value that is not a list is no components: the stack draws nothing, and a Reset is Failure (no components)
row C109 — a page with no component is not found, by its id and by its label (Failure each); the start page is Unchanged
row C107 — a push to a page whose component the project does not have is Failure (not found); the next push is Done
Start Page picks the start page; changing it takes effect at the next Reset
a Popup with Duration 100 and Delay 50: two children until the first frame past 150 ms
a Pop while the push still plays is Failure transition-in-progress; after it, the back puts the page below back (two children), and a second Pop during the back is refused too
a push while a back plays is refused; after it the stack is one shallower and a push is Done
a Reset during a push's animation rebuilds the start page, but the stack refuses pushes until the old animation ends
Mounted off during a push's animation: the animation still ends (one child); Mounted on rebuilds the start page
an animated replace: Stack Depth 1 at once, two children until the animation ends
two Resets in one frame: one reset, both Done
Components changed while on the page: the stack resets at the frame's end
row C113 — writing Name, the name the stack already has, keeps its pages: Detail stays on top, Stack Depth 2
a push and a rename in the same frame: the push is Done, then the rename's reset rebuilds the start page — no change seen
a Pop in a replaced page reaches no stack
two pushes and two Pops in one frame: the Pops are the start page's and reach nothing; a Pop in the next frame pops Settings
a push with nothing in it is the start page — Unchanged

row C110 — a Reset during a back's animation: when the animation ends it takes only the page it popped off the stack — the new start page stays, a push after is Done, and the same push again Unchanged
a Reset during an animated replace: the start page is built; the replace's end deletes only the pages it was replacing
two pushes and a replace waiting under Other, replayed when the stack is renamed: reset, push, push, replace — all Done
a replace alone waiting under Other replays with no reset
a push while the stack is off the page waits in the handler and lands when it comes back: Detail on top
row C112 — Components emptied after a push: the pages go, and Top Component Name '' and Stack Depth 0 say the stack is empty; a Reset is Failure
an animated push lands before an advance moves the clock: the animation starts at 0 and ends at the first frame past 300
an animated push, then an advance past its end before any frame: the first frame ends it — one child throughout
Name blank or null is Main: a push to a blank name reaches it, and writing either keeps the stack — Settings on top, Stack Depth 3 (row C113)
Mounted off and on in the same frame: nothing
a Pop and a Reset in the same frame: the Pop pops, the Reset rebuilds the start page; a Pop in the next frame reaches nothing
a replace and a Pop in the same frame: the replace deletes the pushed page first, so its Pop asks nothing

Components changed to leave out the page below, then a Pop in the same frame: the reset the Components write scheduled runs first, so the Pop finds no page the stack pushed and asks nothing; the stack starts again at Detail

row C111 — a Pop, then Components changed to leave out the page below, in one frame: the Pop is refused (Failure, page not found) before anything moves — the pusher hears nothing — and the reset starts the stack at Detail
the same, with two pages left
a push with no transition key plays Push (300 ms); its Pop plays it back: the popped page goes at the first frame past 600
a replace onto a stack with nothing on it builds its page, unanimated
a stack with nothing on it, then Components and a push in one frame: the reset the Components write schedules builds the start page first, and the push lands on it — Done, Stack Depth 2
two replaces behind a reset that threw: the queue frees two act boundaries later — the first throws too, the second meets Components cleared and is refused
the same with two pushes
one replace behind a reset that threw, Components cleared before the frame's end: refused
a push and forty Pops in one frame: every Pop is the start page's — nothing; the push is Done
forty Pops on the start page: nothing
a refused push, a push, and Components emptied in one frame: refused, Done — then the reset finds no components and the outputs say the stack is empty (row C112)
a replace of the only page is Unchanged once — the next frame says nothing — and a Reset after is Done
a replace at the act that remounts the stack: the remount's reset, then the replace
a Reset and a replace behind the mount's refusal: both refused at the yield; Components given and a Reset, Done
a push and a replace behind the mount's refusal: refused; Components given rebuild the stack, a push is Done
placed off the page, then Mounted on and a push at once: the act's paint mounts it — Did Mount, the start page, then the push
a replace waits while the stack is off the page; an act that remounts it replays it, refused, and the act's own replace is Done
a Reset, a push and a replace with no components: all refused; Components given, then a push is Done
a Reset and a push behind the mount's refusal: refused at the yield; Components given rebuild the start page
a Reset, a push and a replace behind the mount's refusal: refused; Components given rebuild the start page
a frame that refuses a Reset and mounts the stack: the mount's reset waits behind it; Components given rebuild the start page
a frame that refuses a Reset and unmounts the stack; remounted with components: the start page, counted with it (v16, row C114)
a Pop at the act that remounts the stack replays a waiting replace (refused); a Reset after is Done
a Reset, a push and a replace behind the mount's build, with Components emptied by the frame's end: the build lands, then all three are refused; Components back and a Reset, Done
a Pop at the act that remounts the stack: the remount's reset deletes the pushed page, and the Pop asks nothing — Home on top
a frame that remounts the stack replays a waiting replace (refused); a Reset after is Done
the matrix — a push of a page it does not have, in a frame with no paint; then a Reset
the matrix — a replace with a page it does not have, in a frame with no paint; then a Reset
the matrix — a push, in a frame with no paint; then a Reset
the matrix — a replace, in a frame with no paint; then a Reset
the matrix — a push of the page on top, in a frame with no paint; then a Reset
the matrix — a Reset, in a frame with no paint; then a Reset

the matrix — a replace with a page it does not have, in a frame where the stack is unmounted; then a Reset

the matrix — a replace, in a frame where the stack is unmounted; then a Reset

the matrix — a Reset, in a frame where the stack is unmounted; then a Reset
the matrix — a push of a page it does not have, in a frame where the stack is mounted again; then a Reset
the matrix — a replace with a page it does not have, in a frame where the stack is mounted again; then a Reset
the matrix — a push, in a frame where the stack is mounted again; then a Reset
the matrix — a replace, in a frame where the stack is mounted again; then a Reset
the matrix — a push of the page on top, in a frame where the stack is mounted again; then a Reset
the matrix — a Reset, in a frame where the stack is mounted again; then a Reset
a Reset behind the mount's refusal is refused at the yield; Components given and a Reset, Done

a push waiting under Other, replayed by a Name write behind a refused reset, runs at the second act's boundary after it and is refused; that act's own replace is answered at the frame's end; Components given and a Reset, Done

a push waiting under Other, replayed by a Name write behind a refused reset, runs at the second act's boundary after it and is refused; that act's own push, of a page the stack does not have, is refused when Components arrive before the frame's end

a push and a replace waiting under Other, replayed by a Name write behind a refused reset: each act boundary after it frees one — the push is refused at the second act, the replace at the third (a replace); that act's own replace, of a page the stack does not have, is refused when Components arrive before the frame's end

a push and a replace waiting under Other, replayed by a Name write behind a refused reset: each act boundary after it frees one — the push is refused at the second act, the replace at the third (a push); that act's own push, of a page the stack does not have, is refused when Components arrive before the frame's end

a replace waiting under Other is refused at the Name write that replays it (a waiting replace replays with no reset); a Reset in that frame lands at the yield — Failure, no components; Components given and a Reset, Done; a push to Other then reaches it
Scroll Into View says nothing on the wire; a push after it is Done
a stack with no components, remounted with Components in the same frame: its start page lands at that frame's yield, Children Count 1 with it (v16, row C114)
a stack showing a page, remounted with no Components: the reset fails and Children Count 0 goes with Stack Depth 0 (v16, row C114)
placed off the page and mounted at a frame: the start page lands at its yield with Children Count (v16, row C114); a push in the next frame is counted at once
Keep Pages When Unmounted ticked: Mounted off and on keeps the pages pushed — Stack Depth stays 2, nothing rebuilt (v17, row C139)
Keep Pages When Unmounted off (the default): Mounted off and on starts again at the start component (row C139)
Keep Pages When Unmounted ticked, Components written while off: the remount starts again (v17, row C139)
Keep Pages When Unmounted ticked, Name moved to another key while off: the remount starts again (v17, row C139)
Keep Pages When Unmounted ticked, a push that waited while off lands on the kept pages (v17, row C139)
Keep Pages When Unmounted ticked with Use Routes, the address where it was left: the remount keeps the pages (v17, row C139)
Keep Pages When Unmounted ticked with Use Routes, a Back while off: the remount starts again at the page in the address (v17, row C139)
ROUTES: placed at #/detail — the start page is the page in the URL: Detail, Stack Depth 1
ROUTES: placed at ?id=1#/settings — Settings, handed the query's id '1': a push of Settings with no parameters is Done, not Unchanged (row C121's consequence)
ROUTES: placed at #/settings — the control: a push of Settings is Unchanged
ROUTES: placed at #/detail/7 with Detail's Path /detail/{id} — Detail, handed id '7' (text): a push of Detail with id '7' is Unchanged, with id 7 Done
ROUTES: Use Routes off, placed at #/settings — the URL is not read: Home
ROUTES: path mode, placed at /settings — the path is read, not the hash: Settings
ROUTES: placed at #/home/more — a pattern matches from the start, a longer URL too: Home
ROUTES: placed at #/nowhere with Start Page Settings — no page matches: the Start Page
row C124 — ROUTES: placed at ?q=%zz#/home — the malformed escape is kept as written: the stack shows Home; a Reset is Done and writes /#/home, the query gone (row C126)
row C124 — ROUTES: Detail's Path /detail/{id}, the person's Back to #/detail/%zz — the malformed escape in the path part is kept as written: the stack starts again at Detail (Stack Depth 1)
row C125 — ROUTES: Detail's Path null is unset (the label's path): the stack is placed at Home

row C125 — ROUTES: Detail's Path null, placed at #/detail — the label's path matches: the stack starts at Detail; a push of Settings writes #/settings, and the person's Back to #/detail shows Detail again
ROUTES: Detail's Path null, placed at #/home — Home's pattern matches first and the reset never reaches Detail's: Home
ROUTES: a push of Detail, then Reset — the Start Page, Home, is rebuilt as the only page and #/home is pushed; a push of Home is then Unchanged (row C126)
ROUTES: placed at #/detail, then Components edited — the rebuild is the Start Page, Home, and #/home is pushed (row C126)
ROUTES: placed at #/settings, the stack starts on Settings; Name written (the same) keeps it (row C113)
ROUTES: a push of Detail — named, then its URL pushed (#/detail), then Done

row C121 — ROUTES: a push of Detail with id 1, then of Settings — ?id=1#/detail, then /#/settings, which clears ?id=1: after the person's Back and Forward Settings has no id, so the same push is Unchanged
row C123 — ROUTES: a push by the page's label, Detail — the URL is #/detail, and the person's Back and Forward read Detail back from it
ROUTES: Detail's Path /detail/{id} — a push with id 'a/b c' and t x: ?t=x#/detail/a%2Fb%20c, and the person's Back and Forward read it back
row C122 — ROUTES: path mode — a push with id 'a b&c' writes /detail?id=a%20b%26c; after the person's Back and Forward the page has 'a b&c' back, so a push with id 'a b' is a new page — Done
row C122 — ROUTES: a push with q '50%' writes ?q=50%25#/detail, and the person's Back and Forward read it back: Detail with q '50%', so the same push is Unchanged
ROUTES: a push with q '50', then the person's Back and Forward — the control: Detail rebuilt with q '50', so the same push is Unchanged
ROUTES: a replace with Settings — its URL replaces the current entry (row C120)
ROUTES: an animated replace (Push) — the URL replaces the entry at the build, before the transition (row C120)
ROUTES: a push, then its Pop — the history steps back at the transition's end, over the entry the push made; its popstate resets nothing (row C120)
ROUTES: a timed push, then its Pop — the history steps back in the first frame past the back's end (row C120)
row C123 — ROUTES: Start Page given by its label, Home — a push, then Reset: the address written for the start page is #/home (row C126)
ROUTES: Home's Path '' and Settings' Path 'Settings' — a push, then Reset: #/Settings, then #/ (row C126)
ROUTES: Use Routes off — a push and a Pop push no URL
ROUTES: Use Routes turned on after the placing — the next push pushes its URL
ROUTES: an Unchanged push and a refused one push no URL
ROUTES: a push, then the person's Back to the bare address — popstate resets: Home, Stack Depth 1
row C119 — ROUTES: Use Routes OFF — a push, then the person's Back: the stack does not hear it — Detail stays on top, Stack Depth 2
ROUTES: a push and its Pop, then the person's Forward to #/detail — the Pop stepped back, so the browser goes Forward to Detail: Detail alone, Stack Depth 1, and its Pop asks nothing (row C120)
ROUTES: the person's Back to ?id=1#/detail — Detail handed id '1': a push of Detail with id '1' is Unchanged
row C124 — ROUTES: the person's Back to ?q=%zz#/detail — the malformed escape is kept as written: the stack starts again at Detail; a Reset then builds Home and writes /#/home (row C126)
ROUTES: Mounted off, then the person's Back — nothing hears it; Mounted on rebuilds the page in the URL
ROUTES: the person's Back, then Mounted off, in one frame — the reset is the frame's: it runs, then the paint unmounts; Mounted on rebuilds
ROUTES: Mounted off, the person's Back and Mounted on, in one frame — the act paints first: the stack unmounts, hears nothing, and remounts at the frame's end
ROUTES: Mounted on, the person's Back, in one frame after an unmount — the act paints the mount, then popstate
ROUTES: the person's Back, then a push, in one frame — the reset to #/detail runs first, then Settings is pushed on it, and its Pop steps the history back
ROUTES: a push, then the person's Back, in one frame — the push first, then the reset at the URL the push wrote
ROUTES: the person's Back during a timed push — the reset rebuilds Settings at once; the push's end, later, removes a page already gone, and a push after it is Done
ROUTES: the person's Back twice and a Reset in one frame — one reset, to the Start Page because a Reset is among them: Home, #/home pushed, the Reset Done (row C126)
ROUTES: Name written (another), then the person's Back, in one frame — the register's reset at once, then popstate's at the frame's end
ROUTES: no components, then the person's Back — the reset finds none and reports to no one
ROUTES: path mode — the person's Back to /detail/5: Detail; Forward to /settings: Settings
row C107 — a replace to a page whose component the project does not have is Failure (not found) — the page it replaced is already gone (Children Count 0); a push after it is Done
row C107 — a Start Page whose component the project does not have: the stack is empty (Top Component Name '', Stack Depth 0) and a Reset is Failure; with the page's component back, a Reset is Done
row C110 — a Start Page the stack does not have: the mount's reset leaves the stack empty, and a push onto it is Failure (stack empty)
row C120 — ROUTES: a page pushed with Use Routes off, then Use Routes on and its Pop — no entry of its own to step back over: the address is replaced with #/home

row C120 — ROUTES: the Pop's own Back is the stack's — Home's Path changes before it lands, so the address #/home names no page, and the stack keeps Home rather than resetting to its first page, Detail
row C120 — ROUTES: the person's Back to the address already on top — a push of Detail, then a Back to #/detail: the address names the page on top, so nothing resets
row C126 — ROUTES: Reset while the address already names the Start Page — Home rebuilt, Done, and nothing written
